hypotheses.title: Batch 98: FFO Margin Convexity & Analyst Buy Flow Elevation Sprint
hypotheses.economic_rationale: High-conviction quota sprint responding to the user's directive to keep trying more data fields and hypotheses. Deploys three targeted candidates combining proven structural mechanisms with unmined factors: (1) Candidate 1: Funds From Operations (FFO) Cash Margin Convexity in fundamental (fnd6_fopo), applying the margin expansion engine of Alpha 27 to pure operating cash generation with zero overlap against today's approved alphas. (2) Candidate 2: Core Domestic EBIT Yield paired with Analyst Buy Recommendation Flow (fnd2_ebitdm & anl4_buy), coupling fundamental operating value with an untouched sell-side consensus upgrade catalyst. (3) Candidate 3: Cash Flow Per Share Sector-Neutral Elevation (actual_cashflow_per_share_value_quarterly), taking the 8-PASS factor from Batch 96 (Sharpe 1.28, Sub-universe 1.32, Self-corr 0.6808) into Sector Neutrality with Decay 5 to elevate Sharpe past 1.50 and Fitness past 1.50. All candidates are 100% unit-clean, zero warnings.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if FFO margin convexity, analyst buy flow, or sector-neutral cash flow fail to produce Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (FFO Operating Cash Margin Convexity): Funds From Operations (fnd6_fopo) captures pure cash generated by corporate operations before discretionary accruals. Pairs 180-day historical cash yield with 120-day expansion in FFO operating margin (fnd6_fopo / (sales * 4)). Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 2 (Domestic EBIT Yield & Analyst Buy Flow): Domestic EBIT (fnd2_ebitdm) delivered a baseline 1.00 Sharpe and 1.05 Sub-universe Sharpe in Batch 91. Couples this fundamental valuation anchor with 60-day revision momentum in analyst buy recommendations (anl4_buy, an untouched field). Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 3 (Sector-Neutral Cash Flow Elevation): Takes the 8-PASS factor from Batch 96 (Sharpe 1.28, Sub-universe 1.32, Self-corr 0.6808) into Sector Neutrality with Decay 5. Sector neutralization enables cross-subindustry cash flow rebalancing, the structural switch that lifted Alpha 26 to Sharpe 1.73 and Fitness 1.56. Evaluated in TOP1000 Sector Neutral with Decay 5.
